name: UK strikes & disruption
summary: Resident doctors in England strike 14–19 Nov; consultants also plan November action
state: The BMA has called a six-day strike by resident doctors in England from 14 to 19 Nov, and consultants have announced a two-day strike in November (NHS Employers). These are strikes in one sector, within the Watch band. No national infrastructure failure had been reported as of 2 Nov.
for_you: Attend appointments unless told otherwise. The NHS will contact you if yours is rescheduled. Use 111 or 999 as usual.
rubric_hit: National strike in one sector (health) = Watch

sources.title: NHS Employers — Consultant doctors announce strikes in November

why: Strikes and infrastructure failures in rail, health, ports and power disrupt daily life and the economy.
drivers: Pay disputes, infrastructure failures, cyber incidents, weather.

rubric.alert: Multiple simultaneous national strikes, or nationwide infrastructure failure.
rubric.watch: National strike in one sector or major infrastructure disruption.
rubric.normal: No national-scale strikes or disruption this week.
